name: SquidRouterModule
rootCause: Attackers exploited the third-party SquidRouterModule installed in Safe (Gnosis Safe) wallets, stealing approximately $3.2 million from at least 86 accounts on Ethereum and Base. The module’s delegation relied on a hardcoded constant, allowing attacker impersonation and unauthorized withdrawals. The SquidRouterModule's executeSameChainActions() function used a hardcoded constant string for delegate validation, allowing attackers to impersonate trusted delegates and bypass authorization in wallets with the module installed.
